Consular.desc: +5 Senate Favor after each won Senate crisis.

refugees.text: A hundred thousand refugees crowd Coruscant’s lower levels. The Senate asks the Order to help.

defector.text: An Imperial officer offers fleet codes for safe passage and a payout.

guard.text: Masters argue the Temple is too exposed. Hire Temple Guard, or trust the Force.

frontline.text: The Senate wants Jedi leading Republic battalions.

opts.t: Refuse: we are not an army

acolyte.text: A young Sith acolyte sits in the Temple cells. What do we do with her?

caravan.text: A kyber shipment can be bought for the Order before the Senate claims it.

expedition.text: Archivists found coordinates to a lost Jedi outpost.

hutts.text: A Hutt clan offers “protection” for Republic convoys near the Temple’s supply lanes.

memorial.text: The war has taken many. Some ask for a memorial in the Temple gardens.

tithe.text: Senators question what the Order does with its stipend.

initiates.text: Force-sensitive teens beyond the usual age ask to train.

spies.text: Intel suggests an Imperial spy in a senator’s office.

bacta.desc: Every wounded unit heals 10 days now.

merc.desc: Hire a rank-3 trooper (needs a free roster slot).

beskar.desc: Unlocks Beskar armor in the Armory.

stims.desc: Unlocks Combat stims (utility) in the Armory.

cortosis.desc: Unlocks Armored robes for Jedi without research.

writs.desc: +8 Senate Favor (the −2 for dealing with Hutts still applies).

jedi: I take no joy in it.
I will be worthy of it.
The Council asks much. I will give it.
troop: Didn’t do it for the stripes.

jedi: I still feel it, some nights.
troop: Doc says it won’t heal right.
